title: arenaria alpina
intro: Arenaria alpina, commonly known as Alpine Sandwort, is a flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is native to the mountainous regions of Europe and Asia and is valued for its numerous health benefits. The plant's therapeutic actions include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to soothe and calm the skin, reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. Arenaria alpina's bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in treating various health conditions.
